goal: Log in with the provided username and password. You will land on the Accounts Overview, which lists accounts and balances in a table. Find the row for the account whose number equals the "accountId" input, read that account's current Balance, and finish — returning it as an output named "accountBalance". The distinctive success text is "Accounts Overview".

inputs.name: accountId
inputs.description: the account number to read the balance of
